key_concepts: Metals are often shiny, strong, and do not break easily
Iron is hard, abundant, and gray in color
Iron is used in spoons, paper clips, coins, nails, and screws
Copper is brown, flexible, and allows electricity to pass through
Copper is used inside electric wires
Gold and silver are shiny metals used in jewelry
Physical properties of materials determine their use
Recycling means making waste materials into useful ones
Paper, plastic bottles, and aluminum cans are recyclable
